apps.name: HasuBackup
apps.desc: Backup — save any installed app as an APK into Download/HasuBackup, back up everything at once, or share an APK.
apps.changes: NEW: Backup all now tells you when it finishes — a "Backup finished" notification (tapping it opens the app) so a long backup is no longer silent if you leave the app while it runs; on Android 13+ it shows once Notifications are allowed, and the Permissions hub lists it. NEW: ↻ Refresh next to the sort pill re-scans your installed apps, so installs and updates show up without reopening the app. FIXED: searching a long list is faster — app icons, APK sizes and versions are now loaded once and cached, instead of re-loading every icon and re-statting every APK on every keystroke.

apps.name: HasuBattery
apps.desc: Battery level, live power details, charge history graph and a full-charge alarm.
apps.changes: NEW: the monitor comes back by itself after a restart or an app update — before this there was no receiver at all, and the "battery_on" switch was written by the app and read by nothing, so after either one the monitor was dead while the switch still said ON; it only restarts when it was on. NEW: turn the monitor off from its own notification — a "Turn off" action on the battery notification stops it without opening the app. FIXED: the charge alarm can now fire again if the level dips below the target while it is ringing and then climbs back — the fired flag used to stay set, so the alarm could never fire again in the same charge session.

apps.name: HasuBoard
apps.desc: The HasuOS keyboard — liquid glass, skins & fonts, GIFs, clipboard, a private vault and Bangla phonetic typing.
apps.changes: NEW: a new app icon — a white glowing keyboard, the HasuOS glow style, in place of the old icon. The About and Guide pages list it.

apps.name: HasuBrowser
apps.desc: Browser — light and fast browsing with bookmarks, history, downloads and desktop mode.
apps.changes: NEW: a 📖 Guide page — tap Guide in the ⋮ menu for a page explaining every button and feature one by one, from the address bar and tabs to the speed dial, downloads and find-in-page. FIXED: the address bar has room to breathe — Forward and Bookmark moved into the ⋮ menu, so the address itself is readable on a narrow phone. FIXED: the tabs sheet no longer grows past the screen with many tabs — the list scrolls inside it. FIXED: the Downloads page only rebuilds when something actually changed, instead of rebuilding every card every second. FIXED: a speed-dial address or name with a quote or bracket in it no longer breaks the whole dial page. FIXED: tabs are now removed from their parent before being destroyed when the browser closes. The Guide and About pages list all six.

apps.name: HasuCalc
apps.desc: Calculator — fast glass calculator with history plus a unit converter for length, weight, temperature, area, speed and data.
apps.changes: Permissions hub at the top of the calculator: HasuCalc honestly needs no permissions at all. NEW: tap a converted result to copy it, like the calculator's own result. FIXED: the last-crash dialog is premium glass now, and a dead ScrollView that was never on screen is gone.

apps.name: HasuCalendar
apps.desc: Calendar — month view with events, times and reminder notifications. Private, no account needed.
apps.changes: Permissions hub at the top of the main screen: Notifications, exact alarms and reminders-after-restart with their real live states, plus a Turn-all-on walk. FIXED: two events made in the same millisecond no longer share an id (one reminder used to overwrite the other), the notification permission is asked once — not on every open, the month grid no longer reloads and re-sorts every event for each of its ~35 cells, and the last-crash dialog is premium glass now.

apps.name: HasuCam
apps.desc: Capture Beyond Limits — pro camera with LMC XML configs, Lib Patcher, AI scene, HDR & Night merge, 20 modes.
apps.changes: The orientation mode is gone, exactly as you ordered: the camera screen now stays straight (portrait) always - no Auto / Portrait / Landscape / Locked button anywhere, the top bar and the All options sheet no longer carry it, and the screen never tilts again. Photos still save upright however you hold the phone, using the phone's tilt sensor.

apps.name: HasuClean
apps.desc: Storage cleaner — find the largest files, duplicate photos and junk folders, and free space safely.
apps.changes: Permissions hub at the top of the main screen: Photos, Videos and Audio (one Storage row on older Android) with their real live states, plus a Turn-all-on walk. FIXED: all three plain system dialogs (last-crash, delete-a-copy, delete-junk) are premium glass now; "Delete all but the newest" no longer deletes several photos on one tap without asking; and the photo-hash and thumbnail streams now close even when a read fails.

apps.name: HasuClock
apps.desc: Clock — alarms with repeat days and snooze, stopwatch with laps, a timer that rings from the background, and world clocks.
apps.changes: FIXED: the alarm editor now scrolls — on a short or sideways screen its Save button used to sit below the screen and could not be reached at all. FIXED: a long message in a confirm dialog (for example the crash details) now scrolls too, so its buttons stay reachable. NEW: the World tab says so when no cities are left, instead of showing a blank list. FIXED: the live clock no longer rebuilds its date formatters on every one-second tick. DESIGN: the app icon on the About page now sits on a glass tile. The Guide and About pages list the editor fix.

apps.name: HasuDice
apps.desc: Dice roller and coin flip — roll 1 to 4 dice with a shuffle animation and a running total, flip a coin with heads and tails tallies, and keep your last rolls on screen.
apps.changes: NEW: Advantage and Disadvantage — pick a single D20 and a Normal / Advantage / Disadvantage row appears; Advantage rolls two D20s and keeps the higher, Disadvantage keeps the lower, the dropped die sits faded on screen, the total line shows both rolls ("Total 17 · 17/12") and the history records them ("17/12=17"); a kept natural 20 or natural 1 is still called out. The choice is remembered, and switching to more dice or another die type goes back to Normal.

apps.name: HasuFiles
apps.desc: File manager — browse all storage, categories for images, videos, music, documents & APKs, search, copy/move, zip & extract.
apps.changes: NEW: a slideshow in the photo viewer — tap ▶ in the bottom bar and a photo shows every few seconds, videos skipped; tap the photo, swipe, or tap ▶ again to stop it. FIXED: the viewer's zoom setup no longer touches a photo that was already freed while swiping fast through the folder. The Guide and About pages list the slideshow.

apps.name: HasuGameBox
apps.desc: Five games in one box — Tic Tac Toe against the computer, classic Snake, Memory Match, 2048 and Tap Rush. Best scores are kept for every game, all offline.
apps.changes: Permissions hub at the top of the game list: HasuGameBox honestly needs no permissions at all — the games run entirely on your phone. NEW: Tic Tac Toe difficulty — Easy (random) or Hard (plays to win). FIXED: filling the whole Snake board no longer freezes the game (you win instead), leaving Tap Rush mid-round no longer breaks its clock, a fast New game in Memory Match can no longer hide the new board's cards, and the last-crash dialog is premium glass now.

apps.name: HasuHabit
apps.desc: Habit tracker — build good habits with streaks, week dots and monthly completion. Tap to mark each day done.
apps.changes: NEW: home-screen widget — today at a glance on your home screen, with each habit's streak flame; tap any habit right on the widget to mark (or unmark) today done without opening the app, and the widget refreshes itself whenever a habit changes, when a reminder is marked done from its notification, after a reboot, and at midnight so the "today" state never goes stale. The widget is glass-styled like the app, shows up to 5 habits with a "+ N more" line, and tapping its title opens HasuHabit.

apps.name: HasuHealth
apps.desc: Health — step counter with 7-day history, daily water tracker with a goal, and a BMI calculator. All on your phone.
apps.changes: FIXED: steps now keep counting in the background — before, the step sensor was listened to only while the app was open, so a morning walk before opening HasuHealth was lost (the day's baseline was set from the counter on first open). A new low-power step service keeps the counter alive all day and restarts after a reboot or an update, so the daily total is right even if you never open the app. The service's notification is the honest control: "Stop counting" stops it and remembers the choice, and the steps card offers to turn it back on. The step accounting itself is unchanged and was unit-tested standalone (8 cases: day flow, counter resets after reboots, idempotent re-feeds).

apps.name: HasuKhata
apps.desc: Daily hisab in taka: month summary, categories and day-by-day entries.
apps.changes: FIXED: the main screen now scrolls as one — the summary card, the category bars and the entry list used to sit in a fixed stack above the list, so in landscape the list was pushed off the bottom of the screen and could not be reached at all; the whole screen scrolls now. FIXED: the entry editor also scrolls, so its Save and Cancel buttons are reachable on a short screen. NEW: tap a category bar to filter the list by that category, across all months — the ✕ in the search box clears it again. FIXED: a failed export no longer leaves a half-written file in Downloads, and its stream now always closes. FIXED: the category chips in an incomplete last row no longer stretch to half the row. The About page icon now sits on a glass tile.

apps.name: HasuLock
apps.desc: App lock — protect any app with a PIN pad and fingerprint unlock.
apps.changes: FIXED: the Permissions toggle at the top of the main screen is honest now — it used to stay blue ON even when a permission was missing; grey + knob left until Usage access and Notifications are really granted, repainted on every return to the main screen. FIXED: the PIN pad now scrolls on short screens, so the bottom rows and the fingerprint button are reachable in landscape. NEW: turn the lock off from its own notification. FIXED: the note under the relock card no longer repeats what the relock card already says. DESIGN: the main screen's app icon now sits on a glass tile.

apps.name: HasuMusic
apps.desc: Music player — songs, albums and artists from your library, background playback with notification controls, shuffle and repeat.
apps.changes: FIXED: the Now playing screen now scrolls as one page — on a short or sideways screen the sleep timer, the equalizer and the queue used to sit below the screen and could not be reached at all. NEW: a voice message or a sat-nav prompt now dips the music quieter instead of stopping it — the volume comes back by itself; a phone call still pauses and resumes as before. NEW: the notification now has a ✕ Stop button, so the music can be ended right from the notification. FIXED: a long message in a confirm dialog (for example the crash details) now scrolls too, so its buttons stay reachable. FIXED: the audio focus is now given back when another app takes it for good and when the service stops. The Guide and About pages list all five.

apps.name: HasuNamaz
apps.desc: Prayer times for Bangladesh — offline calculation, next-waqt countdown, Qibla compass and per-waqt alarms.
apps.changes: NEW: a monthly timetable — tap 📅 Month at the top to see every day of this month with all six prayer times in 12-hour, today highlighted, calculated offline like the rest of the app. FIXED: prayer alarms now re-arm after a clock change, a timezone change or an app update, not just after a reboot. FIXED: the alarm notification now carries HasuNamaz's own icon instead of the system alarm glyph. FIXED: the Qibla compass no longer allocates a fresh rotation matrix on every sensor event.

apps.name: HasuNews
apps.desc: Bangla news — Prothom Alo and BBC Bangla headlines, articles open inside the app, and last headlines stay saved for offline reading.
apps.changes: NEW: add your own RSS feeds — tap ＋ Feed, give it a name and address, and it appears as a new tab next to Prothom Alo and BBC Bangla; long-press a feed's tab to remove it. Caches are now keyed by each feed's address, so removing a feed can never hand another feed's headlines over. NEW: a ✕ button on the search box clears it in one tap. FIXED: the app's web identity now carries its real version instead of a hardcoded old one.

apps.name: HasuNotes
apps.desc: Notes — quick private notes with pinning, colours and search. Auto-saves, no account, everything stays on your phone.
apps.changes: NEW: ↗ Export — save every note to a text file you choose, with its title, date and checklist marks intact. FIXED: searching a big collection stays smooth — the list is read once and filtered in memory instead of re-reading the file on every letter you type. FIXED: the list no longer rebuilds its date formats for every note on every redraw. The Guide and About pages list all three.

apps.name: HasuOS Home
apps.desc: Your home screen, HasuOS style — a liquid-glass launcher with widgets, an App Library, lock screen and themes.
apps.changes: FIXED: every screen now starts below the real status bar — the home screen, Search, App Library, Today, folders and Customize all use the phone's actual status-bar height now. Before, Search, App Library, Today and Customize used a fixed 18dp (14dp for Customize), which is shorter than the status bar, so the 'App Library' title, the Customize top bar and the top of the Today cards sat a few pixels underneath it; the home screen used a fixed 34dp guess instead of the real height. FIXED: update badges now refresh while the home screen is open — when HasuStore finds an update for an app, the orange ⬆ appears on the app's icon as soon as it is found, without leaving and coming back. The About and Guide pages list both.

apps.name: HasuPDF
apps.desc: PDF tools — photos to PDF, merge PDFs and split out pages, saved to Download/HasuPDF.
apps.changes: NEW: an in-app PDF viewer — the app's biggest missing piece is closed. Until now tapping a PDF handed it to whatever other viewer the phone had; now it opens inside HasuPDF, one sharp page at a time at screen width, with Prev / Next, a Go-to-page jump, and the current page remembered across rotation. Only one page bitmap is ever held in memory, so even a long document stays light. Tapping a PDF in My PDFs now opens this viewer instead of the system chooser.

apps.name: HasuQuick
apps.desc: A floating assistive ball — favourite apps and quick actions (home, torch, lock, screenshot) anywhere.
apps.changes: NEW: long-press the ball switches the torch on or off at once, without opening the panel — one hand, no panel needed. NEW: long-press an app in the ball's panel to take it off — the first press only arms it, so a stray press never drops an app; long-press the same app again and it is removed, and it can be added back from Choose apps. FIXED: the panel opens faster with many favourite apps — their icons and names are now cached instead of reloaded fresh every time the panel opens. The Guide and About pages list all three.

apps.name: HasuRadio
apps.desc: Live radio — Radio Foorti, Bangladesh Betar, Jago FM, Peoples Radio, Radio Today and BBC World Service, with favourites and background playback.
apps.changes: Permissions hub at the top of the first screen: Notifications with its real live state, plus Internet and network state as install-time grants. NEW: add your own station by name and stream URL, and remove an added station with a long press. FIXED: after a stream error, Retry now really starts a fresh player (the dead player is released instead of tapped again); a prepare that finishes after a newer play started no longer starts the wrong stream; the notification permission is asked once, not on every open; the sleep timer stays in step after rotation; the last-crash dialog is premium glass now.

apps.name: HasuScan
apps.desc: QR & barcode scanner with torch and gallery scan — plus a QR maker for text, links, Wi-Fi and more.
apps.changes: Permissions hub at the top of the first screen: Camera with its real live state, plus Vibration as an install-time grant. FIXED: top text now clears the status bar on every phone (it used a fixed 30 dp); clearing history asks first instead of deleting everything on one tap; history times are always 12-hour now; a failed QR save no longer leaves a 0-byte picture and an open stream behind; gallery scans no longer leak the photo stream or the unscaled bitmap; the last-crash dialog is premium glass now.

apps.name: HasuShare
apps.desc: Offline file sharing — pick files, share them over WiFi or hotspot, and the other phone downloads them from your browser address. No internet needed.
apps.changes: NEW: the share address now shows as a QR code — the other phone just scans it instead of typing an IP address by hand (any camera reads it; HasuScan opens it straight into the browser). The code renders once per address, off the UI thread, and hides the moment sharing stops. FIXED: the sharing notification now carries HasuShare's own icon instead of a system share glyph. The Receive page now tells the other phone to scan the code.

apps.name: HasuShikha
apps.desc: English words — 120 common words with Bangla meanings and examples. Flip the card, mark what you know, review what you missed.
apps.changes: NEW: Quiz mode — the test loop flashcards alone cannot give. Ten questions per round: a Bangla meaning, four English words, pick the right one. Right answers turn green, wrong ones red with the correct word shown, and the round ends with your score, your best score kept, and a Play-again button. It sits on the main screen as its own pill, next to Listen and All words.

apps.name: HasuShot
apps.desc: Screenshots & screen recording from a floating button — gallery, crop, edit and recycle bin built in.
apps.changes: NEW: a 3-2-1 countdown before a recording starts — the number floats on its own overlay and is never in your video; tap the number to cancel it, or tap Cancel countdown on the Recording tab. FIXED: the crop rectangle now stays in the same place on the picture when you turn the phone — it used to stay in stale coordinates. FIXED: drawn strokes now stay on the right pixels when you turn the phone — strokes are filed against the picture itself now, so turning the phone cannot move them on screen or in the saved file. The Guide and About pages list all three.

apps.name: HasuSpeed
apps.desc: Live internet speed in your notification — download & upload now, today's totals and per-app usage.
apps.changes: NEW: 🏆 Peak speed today — the fastest download and upload of the day, shown under the graph; it resets at midnight and survives a restart. FIXED: the notification's drawn pictures now use half the memory — the big panel and the large icon are built in 16-bit colour (their backgrounds are solid, so nothing looks different), instead of allocating a full 32-bit picture on every rebuild. The Guide and About pages list both.

apps.name: HasuStore
apps.desc: Your HasuStore — every HasuOS app, in one place. Online updates included.
apps.changes: Bundled copies refreshed to live — HasuCam 20.73 → 20.75 and HasuOS Home 10.22 → 10.24 — so installing either of them offline gives the newest version. FIXED: the Recent updates page now has a Back button like every other page — before, only the system back key could leave it. FIXED: the status line no longer says ‘Up to date’ while the first check is still running — it says ‘Checking for updates…’ until the real state is known. The About page’s Highlights now give the ‘versions read from the real APK files’ line its own icon instead of repeating the search line’s magnifier.

apps.name: HasuTasbih
apps.desc: Digital tasbih — a big tap circle for dhikr counting: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar and La ilaha illallah, targets of 33, 99 or 100, rounds and a lifetime total, all remembered.
apps.changes: FIXED: the header no longer shows the title twice — the app was missing its own NoActionBar theme, so Android drew its dark system title bar above the app's own header. The app's theme is applied now, so there is exactly one clean header with the title and the info pill fully on screen.

apps.name: HasuTask
apps.desc: To-dos — tasks with a date, time and priority, and reminders that fire on time. Filter by Today, All or Done.
apps.changes: NEW: Permissions hub at the top of the main screen — Notifications and Exact alarms with their real live states, plus Reminders-after-restart and Vibration as install-time grants, and a Turn-all-on walk. NEW: search your tasks from the box above the list. FIXED: the date and time pickers are premium glass now (no plain system dialogs left), the last-crash dialog is premium glass now, the notification permission is asked once — not on every open, tasks with no date now sort after dated ones, and the crash-report stream now closes properly.

apps.name: HasuTools
apps.desc: Tools — compass, bubble level, real-size ruler and a torch with strobe and SOS modes.
apps.changes: NEW: Permissions hub at the top of the main screen — Camera and Microphone with their real live states, plus Vibration as an install-time grant, and a Turn-all-on walk. FIXED: Strobe and SOS no longer keep blinking after you leave the Torch tab with no way to stop them — leaving the tab stops the blinking (a steady torch stays on); the torch button now always shows the torch's real state. The torch asks for the Camera permission on the spot instead of failing silently, the microphone is asked once per session instead of on every Sound visit, and the last-crash dialog is premium glass now.

apps.name: HasuUsage
apps.desc: Usage — see where your time goes: screen time and data per app for today, yesterday and the last 7 days.
apps.changes: NEW: Permissions hub at the top of the main screen — Usage access with its real live state and a Turn-all-on walk; the app needs exactly that one permission. NEW: the 7-day view now shows your daily average next to the total. FIXED: the last-crash dialog is premium glass now, the no-access screen is a glass card instead of plain text, the crash-report file streams now close properly, and per-app data queries now close their NetworkStats handles even when a query fails.

apps.name: HasuVault
apps.desc: A private vault for photos, videos & PDFs — AES-256 encryption, PIN and fingerprint lock.
apps.changes: NEW: Permissions hub at the top of the main screen — Fingerprint unlock with its real live state (tap the row to flip the vault's own switch, or enrol a fingerprint from the system page) plus Vibration as an install-time grant, and a Turn-all-on walk. SECURITY FIXED: the vault is now hidden from the Recents screen — lock screen, grid and viewer can no longer appear in app-switcher previews — and decrypted PDF copies left in the cache are now wiped (files older than an hour, on every return to the vault and before each new view). FIXED: the main screen, About page and viewer top bars now sit below the status bar for real; the last-crash and delete dialogs are premium glass now; the thumbnail cache is capped instead of growing with every photo; a failed import no longer leaves a half-written encrypted blob behind; crash-report streams now close properly.

apps.name: HasuVoice
apps.desc: Voice recorder — one-tap recording with a live level meter, playback, rename and share.
apps.changes: NEW: Permissions hub at the top of the main screen — Microphone and Notifications with their real live states, plus a Turn-all-on walk. NEW: a Recording card now sits in the notification shade while you record (tap it to come back to the recorder) — recording with the screen off is no longer silent and invisible. NEW: search your recordings by name. FIXED: recording file names now use the 12-hour clock (the old names carried a 24-hour stamp); the last-crash dialog is premium glass now; renaming can no longer smuggle a slash into a file name; deleted and renamed recordings no longer leave stale entries in the duration cache; crash-report streams now close properly.

apps.name: HasuWall
apps.desc: Your gallery — photos & videos with editors, live wallpapers, favourites and a recycle bin.
apps.changes: NEW: a 📖 Guide page — tap 📖 at the top of the home screen for a page that explains every button and feature of HasuWall one by one, from the gallery tabs and the photo and video viewers to the editors and the online backup. FIXED: a photo that will not load no longer leaves the previous photo on screen with no word — the viewer now clears the picture and says it could not be loaded. DESIGN: the app icon on the About page now sits on a glass tile. The Guide and About pages list the Guide.

apps.name: HasuWeather
apps.desc: Weather — current conditions and a 7-day forecast for any city on earth, powered by Open-Meteo.
apps.changes: NEW: Permissions hub at the top of the main screen — Location with its real live state, plus Internet and Network state as install-time grants, and a Turn-all-on walk. NEW: a 📍 My location button — the weather where you are, with the place named on the map (last fix reused when fresh, one fresh fix with a timeout otherwise). FIXED: a damaged saved coordinate can no longer crash the app on launch (it falls back to Dhaka); the network reader now closes properly even when a download fails; sunrise and sunset can no longer fall back to a 24-hour stamp; the no-internet screen is now a glass card with a working ↻ Retry button; the last-crash dialog is premium glass now; crash-report streams now close properly.

apps.name: HasuOS
apps.desc: Every HasuOS app in one place — the whole family with its details, straight from the live catalogue. Tap any app for its story, version and size, and get it through HasuStore.
apps.changes: Your brand logo now has a fully transparent background - no black box. The HO mark floats clean on any wallpaper, and the website logo uses the same transparent version.

apps.name: Hasu
apps.desc: Hasu's whole details in one app — a living portfolio: name, role, story, work and contact, all editable on the phone. The developer behind HasuOS.
apps.changes: Permissions hub at the top of the portfolio: Hasu honestly needs no permissions at all. NEW: share your details as text from the main page. FIXED: the website row in Contact was dead — it opens the site now; a corrupt photo no longer crashes the editor (and its streams close properly); the last-crash dialog is premium glass now.

apps.name: HasuTube
apps.desc: YouTube inside its own HasuOS app: home feed, Shorts, subscriptions and library, built-in search and real full-screen video.
apps.changes: NEW: a 📖 Guide page — tap ℹ️ in the header, then Guide, for a page explaining every button and feature one by one, from the sections and search to picture-in-picture, uploads and the no-connection card. FIXED: searching no longer leaves the wrong section chip highlighted — results light up Home now, instead of leaving the last section lit. The Guide and About pages list both.

apps.name: HasuWeb
apps.tag: The HasuOS website, as an app
apps.desc: The HasuOS website inside its own app: the same pages and the same live catalogue, served by the website's own server — every app update shows here the moment it reaches the website.
apps.changes: NEW: a 📖 Guide page — tap ℹ️ in the header, then Guide, for a page explaining every button and feature one by one, from the site itself to find-in-page, pinch to zoom and the no-connection card. FIXED: Find in page no longer flashes Not found while it is still counting matches — it waits until the count is done. DESIGN: the About page icon now sits on a glass tile. The Guide and About pages list all three.

apps.name: HasuMaps
apps.tag: The HasuOS map — the world, in glass
apps.desc: His idea, straight from his message: Google Maps, the HasuOS way. The full OpenStreetMap in one glass window — search any place on Earth, directions for car, bike and foot, and a Locate button that centres the map on you from your phone's GPS. No API key, no Google services: open map data, plus the family Permissions hub and About page.
apps.changes: NEW: 🧭 Recent trips — every route you run is now kept in ⭐ Saved, newest first: From → To with its distance, time and date, plus a stop when one was on the way. One tap re-runs the trip, and a trip that started from 'My location' starts from where you are now. Long-press a trip to forget it. A re-route mid-navigation is never recorded. The Guide and About pages list it.

apps.name: HasuAssist
apps.desc: Your HasuOS chat assistant — a real AI chat in glass: questions, study and exam help, writing, translation, maths and ideas, in Bengali, English or any language. Voice typing, chats saved on your phone. Needs the internet; no account, no sign-up.
apps.changes: Draw pictures: tap the paint button, describe anything, and the picture appears right in the chat — tap it to see it big and save it to your gallery. Edit your own message: long-press it and choose Edit, fix the words and Send for a fresh answer. Hear any answer read aloud: long-press it and choose Listen. And the app now retries by itself when the AI service hiccups, so the could-not-answer warning rarely appears.
